snippet.description:
Does your academic background give you an advantage in UPSC Mains answer writing?

Nishat Sir, Sociology Optional Faculty at LevelUp IAS, breaks down the common myth that Humanities students are naturally better at answer writing than engineers.

The truth is that answer writing is a skill that can be learned and improved through proper training. Even Humanities students may need to move away from the university-style answer writing they are accustomed to and adapt to what UPSC Mains actually demands.

Your degree doesn’t decide your answer writing. The right training does.
